title: Reikai Monogatari
author: onisaburo-deguchi
attributionNote: A vast narrative attributed to Onisaburō Deguchi’s spiritual inspiration. It is a modern Oomoto text, not an ancient chronicle.
description: An extensive revelatory narrative describing the spirit world, divine plan and moral order. It is central to Oomoto but is not treated as a universal scripture.
historicalContext: Produced in interwar Japan during Oomoto’s expansion and persecution. Its status and interpretation vary within the movement.
availabilityNote: Catalogue record only. Modern text and translations are rights-managed. No text is imported.
